name: dps-maps
description: Search your Dungeon Painter Studio asset library, look at assets, read and save .dps maps, and preview them from the real assets.
long_description: Tools for making Dungeon Painter Studio battle maps with Claude: search the installed asset packs (with sizes in squares), get numbered picture sheets of assets, list and read the maps in your Maps folder, save new maps (existing maps are never overwritten) and render a preview of a .dps map from the real asset images, with Roll20 walls drawn on top if wanted.

tools.name: dps_find_assets
tools.description: Search assets by words, kind and collection, with sizes in squares

tools.name: dps_asset_sheet
tools.description: Numbered picture sheet of assets with a square grid

tools.name: dps_list_maps
tools.description: List maps, exports and Roll20 wall lines in the Maps folder

tools.name: dps_read_map
tools.description: Read a .dps map (summary or full JSON)

tools.name: dps_write_file
tools.description: Save a new .dps map or .roll20.txt line (never overwrites your maps)

tools.name: dps_preview
tools.description: Render a .dps map from the real assets, optionally with Roll20 walls

tools.name: dps_export
tools.description: Open a map in DPS and export its JPG (takes mouse and keyboard briefly)

dps_install.title: Dungeon Painter Studio folder
dps_install.description: The DPS install folder (it contains data\collections).

maps_dir.title: Maps folder
maps_dir.description: Where your .dps maps and exports are saved.
